narrative.summary: CVE-2024-21762 (Fortinet FortiOS Out-of-Bound Write Vulnerability) is a critical vulnerability with CVSS 9.8, sourced from the KEV program.
narrative.affected_summary: Two internet-facing assets are affected: PWR-FW-01 (hostname nrldc-edge-fw01, sector power) running FortiOS 7.2.6 (fixed in 7.2.7) and BNK-FW-01 (hostname bank-dc-fw01, sector banking) running FortiOS 7.0.13 (fixed in 7.0.14). Both have criticality 5.
narrative.exploit_summary: The vulnerability is listed in the CISA KEV catalog (added 2024-02-09) and a public exploit is reported. EPSS score is 0.846 (percentile 0.997). One early-warning signal was observed: a new KEV entry detected on 2026-10-31T19:21:08.202370+00:00 (simulated). No exploit database entry is available.
narrative.why_it_matters: The vulnerability is actively exploited in the wild and exists on high-criticality, internet-facing firewalls in our environment, making it a top remediation priority.
recommended_actions: Upgrade PWR-FW-01 to FortiOS 7.2.7 or later, or apply the vendor-provided mitigation
Upgrade BNK-FW-01 to FortiOS 7.0.14 or later, or apply the vendor-provided mitigation
Restrict internet exposure of the affected interfaces until the patches are applied
Review the source references for additional context before taking action
